headlines.description: — Braxton Ashcraft won his fourth consecutive start and the Pittsburgh Pirates defeated the Washington Nationals 7-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ashcraft wins 4th straight start as Pirates topple Nationals 7-1

events.name: Minnesota Twins at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Josh Bell homered in consecutive at-bats and the Minnesota Twins hit six homers in a game for the first time in nearly three years to pull away for an 11-4 victory over the slumping New York Yankees on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Bell homers twice as Twins go deep six times in 11-4 victory over Yankees

headlines.description: — Riley Greene hit a two-run homer in the first inning, Jack Flaherty pitched three-hit ball over 5 2/3 innings and the Detroit Tigers beat the Texas Rangers 3-0 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Greene homers in 1st inning and trio of Tigers pitchers combine on 3-hit shutout win over Rangers

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Logan Gilbert gave up one hit and struck out seven in 7 1/3 innings, Randy Arozarena hit a grand slam, and the Seattle Mariners beat the Toronto Blue Jays 11-0 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariners rout Blue Jays 11-0 as Logan Gilbert allows 1 hit over 7 1/3 innings

headlines.description: — Samuel Basallo hit a three-run homer in the first inning and the Baltimore Orioles roughed up Cincinnati's Hunter Greene in his first start of the season for an 8-5 win over the Reds on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Basallo hits a 3-run homer as the Orioles rough up Greene, beat the Reds 8-5

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Colson Montgomery hit a go-ahead homer in the eighth inning off Tim Herrin for the second of his two RBI, helping the Chicago White Sox beat the Cleveland Guardians 3-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Montgomery homers to break tie, White Sox beat Guardians 3-1 to retake AL Central lead

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Yordan Alvarez hit a two-run homer off Casey Legumina with no outs in the ninth inning to cap a big night and give the Houston Astros a 10-8 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alvarez hits 2-run homer in 9th to cap big night with Astros' 10-8 victory over Rays

events.name: New York Mets at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Michael Harris II had three hits, including one of five Braves home runs, as Atlanta gave Chris Sale plenty of support in a 14-3 blowout over the New York Mets on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Braves unleash 5 homers in a 14-3 rout of the Mets as Chris Sale earns win

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Rookie JJ Wetherholt homered and doubled, Kyle Leahy threw five crisp innings and the St. Louis Cardinals beat the Chicago Cubs 3-0 at
headlines.shortLinkText: Wetherholt has HR, 3 hits to lead Cards past Cubs 3-0 at foggy Wrigley

events.name: Philadelphia Phillies at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Jesús Luzardo struck out nine in six innings, J.T. Realmuto, Gabriel Rincones Jr. and Alec Bohm hit home runs, and the Philadelphia Phillies beat the Kansas City Royals 6-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luzardo dominates Royals as Phillies hit three homers in 6-1 win

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Robbie Ray threw six efficient innings after regrouping from a fall while covering first base, Willy Adames hit a two-run double as part of a four-run opening frame and the San Francisco...
headlines.shortLinkText: Robbie Ray throws 6 innings, Willy Adames helps fuel 4-run opening frame as Giants beat Rockies 6-4

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Willson Contreras and Romy Gonzalez homered to back the superb pitching of Sonny Gray, who allowed one run and four hits in six innings of the Boston Red Sox’s 8-1 win over the Los Angeles Angels on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Homers by Contreras, Gonzalez back Gray's strong start in Red Sox's 8-1 win over Angels

headlines.description: — Sandy Alcantara allowed one run with a season-high eight strikeouts in eight innings to win his seventh consecutive start, leading the Miami Marlins past the Athletics 7-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alcantara sharp, Lopez homers to pace the Marlins past the A's, 7-2

headlines.description: — Adrian Del Castillo hit a three-run home run in the first inning and the Arizona Diamondbacks held on to beat the Milwaukee Brewers 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Del Castillo hits 3-run homer to lift Diamondbacks past Brewers 4-3

events.name: San Diego Padres at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Yoshinobu Yamamoto struck out 10 in seven innings, Freddie Freeman homered and the Los Angeles Dodgers beat San Diego 3-0 on Saturday night, handing the Padres their eighth consecutive loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yamamoto has 10 strikeouts as Dodgers send Padres to 8th straight loss
